decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range costs little to maintain as a pharmacy line and still holds several sub-options whose value remains uncertain, so keeping it open is the sensible choice.
The skin and hair supplement got its own page and a launch announcement, and its low carrying cost justifies keeping it while demand evidence builds.
Joint health is a steady pharmacy segment, and the product was moved up to its own page in 2019, so nothing signals abandonment yet.
The immune supplement was promoted as the newest Trivital product, and immune demand during the pandemic years likely improved its prospects, so keeping it is cheap and worthwhile.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall hurt this generic's value, but it was still listed in 2019 and blood pressure generics are a core product, so it is likely kept with clean active ingredient despite an elevated risk of being dropped.
The over-the-counter triptan is a recent launch in a niche that fits the firm's pain and migraine focus, and its value is still unfolding, so the option should stay open.
